note: Chapter Plans (Stage 6) for Ash and Oath -- expansive build (~28 chapters, ~100k+), dual POV (Tomas + Soraya), assigned organically by whose experience is central. Part One is weighted heavily to earn the tragedy through a long slow burn and the daily life of the fold; Part Two falls fast. Maps the 14 beats (see beat-sheet.json) onto chapters. This is the architecture; detailed per-chapter plans (Goal, Scenes, Ends-with) are filled in next, part by part. Target ~3500-4000 words/chapter.
openNeeds: The expansive Part One needs SECONDARY DRAGONKIN to populate the fold and give the massacre named faces -- e.g., a fold elder, a dragonkin child Tomas bonds with, a friend/rival of Soraya's. Build a small secondary-character pass before or during Part One detailing. Also: how the hyenadin menace is seeded across the stay; deeper Geistkin/Stonekin detail if they surface.

chapters.title: The Charge
chapters.goal: Establish Tomas (Ser Warrant), the oath as real faith-magic, Marrenhold's fragility, and Rowan the maker-father; the charge to move the dragonkin; ride out with Wat.

chapters.title: The Standoff
chapters.goal: Arrival at the mesa and the blighted land; first sight of the dragonkin; Kaelen and Soraya; the threat he was sent for starts to look like a grieving people.

chapters.title: Among the Cursed
chapters.goal: The fold from within -- establish Soraya's POV, the tribe's grief and discipline, secondary dragonkin, and the human read as the face of their expulsion.

chapters.title: The Bargain
chapters.goal: The deal struck on trust; Tomas offers himself as guarantor; Wat sent home for the price; the clock starts.

chapters.title: The Guarantor
chapters.goal: The fold's unease at a human hostage in their midst; Kaelen's terms and wariness; watching the collateral falls to Soraya as heir.

chapters.title: The Keeper
chapters.goal: Cold, correct duty; wary proximity; her discipline; the daily rhythm of the fold seen through its heir.

chapters.title: What They Are
chapters.goal: Learning the curse's daily cost -- defense-only, the shield-wings, the doomed green; the threat dissolving into people; meeting secondary fold members.

chapters.title: Among Them
chapters.goal: Daily life in the fold -- work, fire, songs, a child, an elder; the orphan noticing, for the first time, what belonging feels like. (Texture / the expansive stay.)

chapters.title: The Ashed Home
chapters.goal: Her wound surfaces -- the home she stayed for and killed, her mother's echo; Kaelen's homeland stories and the guilt between father and daughter.

chapters.title: A Place to Belong
chapters.goal: The buried heart stirs; his dark-stone past surfaces; the orphan-nobody realizes he has found a fold, and fears how much he wants it.

chapters.title: The Weight She Carries
chapters.goal: Her burden as heir to a cursed people; her guard cracking against her will; the discipline of wanting nothing she cannot carry, tested.

chapters.title: The Doomed Green
chapters.goal: A quiet intimacy -- Soraya wakes green from bare earth for him, her gift-and-curse in one image; tenderness deepens.

chapters.title: Closer
chapters.goal: The two amputees recognize each other; a near-confession; Kaelen watching, afraid of what he sees coming.

chapters.title: The Line
chapters.goal: Tomas torn between the growing love and his charge and oath; a moment of pulling back before the point of no return.

chapters.title: The Blaze
chapters.goal: The bond-stone ignites -- his god names Soraya his soul-mate, the forbidden one; shaken past hiding, he gives her his name, Tomas.

chapters.title: After the Blaze
chapters.goal: Her side -- terror and wonder; she knows better than anyone what wanting him could cost him; the fold and Kaelen learn of it.

chapters.title: The Bonding
chapters.goal: The choice to wed; Kaelen's dread; the elders' unease at a human rite; her fear it will destroy him -- and choosing anyway.

chapters.title: The Trial
chapters.goal: The metaphysical trial -- body remade in agony, Ser Warrant shed to nobody-Tomas, the glimpse of the slain progenitor's spirit and the curse's assault, the bond damaged.

chapters.title: The Voice
chapters.goal: The ceremony plane -- the god manifests as opalescent light, acknowledges the curse, the three aspects question the bride, blesses the couple and warns a disaster is coming; they emerge bonded, transformed, wholly of the fold.

chapters.title: The Caravan Returns
chapters.goal: Wat returns with the resources -- and the war-summons; the deal fulfilled, Tomas free to go, and the choice detonates on a man who has found his home.

chapters.title: The Summons Falls
chapters.goal: Her side -- the fold preparing to move, the weight of the war-news, her dread; the hyenadin first glimpsed circling the mesa.

chapters.title: The Weight
chapters.goal: Oath, Rowan, Wat, and Marrenhold's survival against the fold, his wife, and the only belonging he has known; the agony of the choice.

chapters.title: The Circling
chapters.goal: The hyenadin gather nearer; the god's warning looms; her fear for Tomas and for the fold he may leave undefended.

chapters.title: She Asks
chapters.goal: She breaks a lifetime's discipline and asks him to stay; he refuses and chooses the oath; he leaves -- his refusal the last thing between them.

chapters.title: The Fall of the Fold
chapters.goal: The hyenadin fall on the mesa; her stand with the divine armaments; Kaelen breaks and looses his fire, dying; the father-daughter reckoning; she falls, last of the fold, never knowing he turned back.

chapters.title: The Smoke
chapters.goal: On the road the bond tears -- he feels her die -- and smoke rises; he orders Wat on to Marrenhold, forsakes the summons and is unmade, and races back.

chapters.title: The Mesa
chapters.goal: The aftermath -- scorched attackers, Kaelen withered on black earth, the fold dead; he finds Soraya last; the severed bond maims him.

chapters.title: Ash and Oath
chapters.goal: The final image -- forsworn, unmade, and maimed, Tomas among the ash with his wife in his arms. Love, people, oath, and self, all lost. Coda at the mesa.
